verdict.rationale: Vercel documents running server-side code on demand with Fluid compute, zero-config Next.js deploys plus 40+ supported frameworks, and git-push deploys, which together deliver serverless functions and full-stack apps without server management. A community user praises its smooth 'code and go' serverless onboarding, though another notes runtime language support is limited to JS/TS/Go. Missing for 10: in-depth function runtime documentation (limits, regions, supported runtimes) beyond one-line doc summaries, and broader language support.
